name: kz.bazar.fx
description: Нейросетевой апскейлер для Unity: renders the scene at low resolution and reconstructs it with a trained CNN running on the GPU (conv 3->8 -> 8->12 -> pixelshuffle x2), then applies Catmull-Rom + TAA + adaptive sharpen. Works in Built-in RP (BazarFXController) and URP (BazarFXNeuralFeature).
